title: Reading Drill — Assessing a new boat storage rack — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Assessing a new boat storage rack — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Ravensmere began with reports of shorter users being unable to reach the upper slots. The boating club caretaker had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using timed trials and chose retrieval time per boat as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was lower supports for small boats. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted ten weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded different boat weights as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
